title: zsuite privacy policy
description: Built into an app. A company that ships its own build edits this file to make privacy settings mandatory.

hideNames.description: Hide names from the assistant. "required" turns it on and locks it for every chat.

findNames.description: Use the downloaded name finder. "required" refuses to send until it is downloaded.

minimumLevel.description: The lowest hiding level a page or file may have.

web.description: Whether the assistant may read web pages.

dataCollection.description: OpenRouter: "deny" uses only providers that do not store or train on what is sent.

zeroRetention.description: OpenRouter: use only providers that keep nothing after the answer.
